description: This file defines a class 'Content' responsible for writing the content of an OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS) to XML format. It handles generating the 'content.xml' which includes styles, sheets, rows, and cells, with support for formulas, merges, and cell styles within the PHPSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Handles writing the content.xml for an ODS file, converting spreadsheet data into the appropriate XML format, including styles, sheets, rows, and cells.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Content writer with the parent Ods object and creates a formula converter.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates the entire content.xml as a string, encoding the spreadsheet data into XML format, including styles and sheets.

methods.name: writeSheets
methods.description: Iterates over all sheets in the spreadsheet and writes their XML representations.

methods.name: writeRows
methods.description: Writes all rows of a sheet, including handling repeated rows for performance.

methods.name: writeCells
methods.description: Writes all cells in a row, managing cell styles, types, formulas, and handling cell spanning.

methods.name: writeCellSpan
methods.description: Handles the XML attributes for cells that are merged or spanning multiple columns.

methods.name: writeXfStyles
methods.description: Writes style definitions for cells, columns, and rows, based on the styles used across sheets.

methods.name: writeCellMerge
methods.description: Adds XML attributes for cells that are merged across multiple rows or columns.
